utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still asking around about who’s organizing the repair drive. If you need an extra hand, I can sort tools or pass out flyers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Nell — could you sort the tools and pass out flyers? I’m rounding up a few volunteers and bringing my spare tools too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I can do both. Just let me know where you want me to start, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep sharing the repair drive, and Dane can help spread the word too. Opal’s tracking who’s coming, so just let me know if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by later and see what they’re short on. If you need, I can ask around for tools or supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Vik — thanks! I’ll keep spreading the word, and if you hear of any tools or supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m a bit late, but I can still help once I’m there. Let me know if there’s anything else you need me to bring over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Dane — if you can, please bring any spare hand tools you’ve got. I can also swing by and help get the missing ones there on time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that — I’ll bring whatever spare hand tools I’ve got over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — I’ll bring the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight. Mara’s bringing spare tools, and Cleo can help round up anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out for the rest of the details and jump in where I can. I can help sort donations or carry a few things, too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Oren — I’ll send the rest when I have it. Donation sorting or carrying things would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — Sam’s helping, right? And Leo’s bringing the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s right — Leo is bringing the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight. Once the date is confirmed, I’ll let Mina know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm: Sam’s still helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s still at the list right now. I’ll check the school calendar and get back to you with the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and help gather anything we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a big help. I’ll check the calendar and send the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this Sunday at the community center, and the drop-off spot is the parking lot by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted the drop-off spot at the community center parking lot by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — and yes, it’s this Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot—if Gus can bring the missing tools on time, I can plan around that. I just need to make sure everything’s there when we start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with the first few tasks for the repair drive. Just let me know when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Bo. If Gus brings the missing tools on time, I can lock in the start time and keep the schedule tight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll bring the spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend. Vik’s stopping by later too, so we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Sam — I’m still trying to line up a few more folks while I’m out running errands. Leo has the tools, so with Vik and your supplies, we’re looking pretty solid.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — keep me posted if you need one more volunteer, and I’ll bring the supplies by later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a volunteer shift and help with the tools. Gus said he can bring them, and I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s message too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That covers the main needs, thanks. We’re still settling on a start time, and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — just send me the start time when it’s set, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Dane was going to check what’s still needed and bring something useful if he can. Cleo’s keeping an eye on the supplies too, so we should be covered.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the donations later. Just let me know when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — I’ll let you know when it’s time to sort them. That’ll really help keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Cleo can help gather what we need for the repair drive, and Gus said he can bring a few tools too. Ira’s been spreading the word while out on errands, and Bo can help with the first few tasks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Tess — thank you. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet over and walk Bo through the first few sign-ups, and we’re all set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Rosa — I’m glad it’s all coming together. Sunday at the community center should go smoothly with everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies, and I can help gather anything we still need. Sam’s looking for spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll stop by later and ask what’s still short. If we need anything, I’ll ask around for tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll keep sorting what we’ve got and flag anything we’re short on. If you hear back about the repair drive, let me know and I’ll help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it still needs a few things, yeah. Maybe ask around and see who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard Sam’s helping with it, and Faye’s checking the school calendar for the time and place. If you need, I can sort tools or hand out flyers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d be great — could you sort the tools or hand out flyers? I’m a bit scattered, but I think Dane can help cover whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can help with the first few tasks, and Sam can watch for your message. Gus has the missing tools, and Ira’s been spreading the word all day.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll bring the screwdriver set, zip ties, and flashlight. Cleo can check the supplies, and Mara’s spare tools should help too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, that should cover it. I’ll take the first few tasks, and we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll gather the spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend for the repair drive. If we still need the missing tools, Gus can bring those by later.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. We still need a clear start time and a few more volunteers, and Rey can help with tools and take a shift.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll ask around for a clear start time and see who else can volunteer. I’m glad Rey can help with the tools and take a shift.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been mentioning the repair drive to folks while I’m out running errands. I’m trying to line up a few more people to मदद out, since Oren’s helping too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps a lot—once the date is confirmed, I’ll check it and let Mina, Gus, Rey, and Uli know right away so we can line everything up on time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—once the date’s set, I’ll keep spreading the word and see if I can get a couple more folks to sign on.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m checking the school calendar now, and I’ll get back to you with the time and place for the repair drive. We’re still at the list for now, but I’ll help spread the word once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye. It’s Sunday at the community center, and the drop-off spot is the parking lot by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — I’ll mark Sunday at the community center and help get the word out. If you want, I can also keep the school schedule in mind for timing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by once the date’s confirmed and see what else still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive at the list right now. Once Faye sends the time and place, I’ll update who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll be there as soon as the time and place are set, and I can help fill any gaps once you’ve got the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the tools and help get any missing ones there on time. Rey can also help with the tools and take a volunteer shift if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That covers it, right? Just making sure we’ve got enough people and tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that should cover the tools and staffing. If anything’s still missing, I can help get it there on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and Dane can help too. Uli’s already been mentioning it out and about, which is great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great—I'll keep connecting folks who need a fix with Ira, and I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules—that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep sharing the repair drive with neighbors and point anyone who needs a fix your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll round up a few volunteers and bring my spare tools. Dane can catch up and pitch in where needed, Faye’s checking the school calendar and spreading the word, and Leo’s bringing the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, that’s shaping up nicely. Gus can bring a few tools too, Cleo’s helping gather what’s needed, Ira’s been spreading the word, and Oren’s sorting donations and carrying a few things.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Tess — we’ve got a solid little team going. I’ll keep lining up volunteers and make sure my tools are ready for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — I’m happy to help sort donations or carry a few things. I’ll wait for Leo’s details on the remaining tasks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Oren — thank you. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet over and walk Bo through the first few sign-ups, and we’ll keep everything centered on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s details and be ready to help with the donations. Thanks for handling the sign-up sheet and Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can lend a hand with tools, and I can take a volunteer shift too. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Sorting donations would really help me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help sort the donations, too. Just point me to where you want me.
